An E-Commerce Website designed to provide a seamless online shopping experience for users. The platform enables product

Hospital Management System: 2025 
A hospital management system using Python is a program designed to manage hospital operations efficiently. It helps handle 
patient records, doctor information, appointments, billing, and medical history. Python is used for backend logic, databases to 
store data, and frameworks in Django for user interfaces. This system makes hospital workflows faster, more accurate, and 
paperless. 
2025 
Event Management System: 
The Event Management System in C aims to simplify the process of managing events efficiently. It allows users to add events, 
register participants, and view event details through a menu -driven interface. The system uses structures and file handling to 
store and retrieve data persistently. It ensures accurate scheduling, registration, and organization of event information. Th is 
project provides a simple yet effective solution for small-scale event management. 
QuizNova: 2025 
QuizNova is an interactive web-based quiz application designed to enhance learning through real-time assessments. 
The system supports timed quizzes, multiple subjects, instant score calculation, and performance tracking. 
It includes secure user authentication, a leaderboard system, and personalized user profiles. 
The platform aims to make learning engaging, competitive, and data-driven for students and faculty.
